author: builder for the finops-cost-lead review (advises, does not sign off)
note: Four further reference scenarios (PLAN F5 item 4), labelled illustrative, built from published provider customer stories and case studies (AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud). Expected outcomes were written BEFORE running the engine, by applying DESIGN.md sections 3, 5, 9 and 10 by hand (a throwaway calculation sheet outside the repository, using exact inputs so the arithmetic is checkable). Sources supply shape only and were read through search-result text (status S), because the proxy blocks the provider sites. No outcome figure from a source is used as an input or benchmark. Money is in each scenario's currency; no FX in value. Same schema as reference-scenarios.json; F5-scenario-diffs.md records the comparison with the engine. Version 1.1.0 applies the F5 practice-lead review (changelog). Real customer names appear only in this internal file and the design notes; client-facing methodology text says "reference scenarios built from public provider case studies" (F5 review L5). The sources are vendor success stories, so the set is biased towards organisations with a story to tell (F5 review M5).

Savings Plans on a small share of compute (coverage 5%; OP-01 Crawl)
Graviton modernisation estimate (VB-05 modernisation)
Engineering-led cost work (UN-01 Run, OP-04 to OP-11 Walk)
scenarioAssumptions: Internal rate EUR 11,000 per FTE-month; tooling EUR 50k a year

headline.statement: 16 of 18 in-scope capabilities with a target are at or above LTM's default target for a Tier 1 estate

value.confidence: Medium (LEV-01 and LEV-07 carry most of the value; exact inputs)
value.label: Indicative value range (conservative / expected / upper), net of estimated implementation cost: not a savings commitment; evidence validation required.

notWorthPursuing.reason: 2% of compute left to move to Spot (60% tolerant, 58% already on Spot): its expected 3-year value at the margin is below its effort, mostly because it displaces LEV-01 (marginal 3-year net about EUR -20k)

scenarios.tolerance: Ratings, gaps, severities and finding IDs must match exactly. Money figures within 1% (rounding) or the difference explained in F5-scenario-diffs.md.
reasoning: Tier 1: about USD 6.5M (1) and Kubernetes material (+1); 2-4 units add nothing. Unit Economics and Invoicing & Chargeback have no Tier 1 target and create no finding.
Only Executive Strategy Alignment (MP-04 Not yet) and FinOps Assessment (MP-11 Not yet) are below their Crawl targets: 16 of 18.
Every quantified lever sits on a capability with no gap, so each gets its own lever finding (CLM-FIN-167).

LEV-07: 3.0M x (1 - 0.55 / 0.65) = 462k upper, 231k expected (3.8% of P net: High). LEV-01: 4.2M compute x (50% - 5% - 10% unscheduled non-production) x compute left after LEV-02, 03 and 07 (92.0% expected) x 66% (Compute Savings Plans, instrument not stated) = 893k upper at the expected point, 446k expected (7.4% of P net: High).
LEV-06 is shown but left out of the headline (M1): 2% of compute x (1 - 5%) is movable, and at the margin it mostly displaces LEV-01.
LEV-03 and LEV-04 are wave 1 quick wins from month 0; the others start in month 3. One-off effort 8 FTE-months (EUR 88k); run cost 1.6 FTE-months (EUR 17.6k) plus tooling EUR 50k.
Upper case 27.7% of P, under the 29% cap.
scenarios.plausibilityCheck: An engineering-led platform that already runs workers on Spot should show little Spot value and mature usage practice, with commitments as the main open lever because Savings Plans cover little; the model shows the same.

previousVersions.note: Superseded by 1.1.0-f5 (see changelog); kept so the comparison in F5-scenario-diffs.md can be traced.

changelog.change: First version: RS6 to RS9, expectations written before the engine ran.

changelog.why: F5 practice-lead review (F5-review.md) H1, H3, M2, M3. Expectations re-written before re-running the engine (engine 3.5.0, value model 1.2.0).
change: RS7 (H3): the practice lead opened the Banco BV story: Cloud Scheduler switches test instances off and GKE features resize idle assets, so OP-06 Not yet -> Walk and OP-05 Not yet -> Crawl; growth 25% -> 10% (the source does not describe a running migration). Source status S -> V.

RS8 (H3): the Generali case runs Spot VM node pools, so OP-08 Not yet -> Walk with a Spot share of 10% of compute (tolerant 20% -> 25%); cluster spend CHF 620k (which matched the case's outcome figures divided back) -> CHF 900k chosen independently. Source status S -> V.

RS6 (M2): BP "encourages" staff to stop VMs at weekends and delete orphaned storage, a manual practice: OP-06 and OP-05 Walk -> Crawl; labelled a 2019 profile assessed as if in 2026. Source status S -> V.
RS9 (M3): steady-state share 50% -> 35% (commitments are never counted on Spot usage; 58% of compute is on Spot).
All (H1, M3): LEV-01 now removes only the non-production LEV-04 acts on (outside clusters and GPUs), and in the workshop the steady share is capped at the compute not on Spot.
RS6, RS7 (E1): Licensing & SaaS and Sustainability written as Not in scope.
